description:
Open-source office suite that edits documents, spreadsheets, slides, PDF, Markdown, code and rich text in one application.

An open-source desktop office suite written in Rust that puts documents, spreadsheets, slides, PDF, Markdown, code and rich text into one application behind a single row of file tabs, with new, open, save, autosave, recovery and printing handled by one shared host.
Documents support paragraph and character formatting, styles, tables, images, headers and footers, page breaks and WMF/EMF pictures. Spreadsheets support multiple sheets, formulas, cell formats, borders and merged cells, and export to PDF and CSV. Presentations support slides, shapes, text boxes, images and layouts, with slideshow and export. PDF work edits existing text and images, adds annotations and text, and inserts, deletes, reorders, rotates, crops, extracts and splits pages.
Markdown offers live preview, task checkboxes, wikilinks, backlinks, tags, outline, a command palette and export. The text editor adds syntax highlighting for more than 20 languages, find and replace, search in folder, line operations and original-encoding round trips. A WYSIWYG HTML editor switches between design and source views.
The same executable is a command line for scripts and AI agents. Verb-first calls create, read, modify, batch and export documents by path without opening a window and can return JSON.
The project is under active development; fidelity on complex documents, input methods and some advanced workflows are still being polished.
